#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""SHIELD // evidence token verification shim.

Checks a candidate token against the case digest. The token itself is not
stored here -- a verifier that carries the answer is not a verifier.
"""
import hashlib
import sys

CASE = "006-17"
DIGEST = "07af9a68cbf30e52f54b3ada87899575b0dd98226a40d9c31f28b2165860db06"


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        candidate = sys.argv[1].strip()
    else:
        candidate = input("[?] Enter token to verify: ").strip()

    if hashlib.sha256(candidate.encode()).hexdigest() == DIGEST:
        print("[+] Token verified against case " + CASE + ".")
        print("[+] File it with SHIELD command to close the case.")
        sys.exit(0)

    print("[-] Verification failed: invalid token. Re-examine your evidence.")
    sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
